scope: Portal Electron cross-target macOS package build

commands.assertions: electron-builder produced unsigned macOS zip packages for x64 and arm64.

commands.command: file extracted Vrooli Portal.app/Contents/MacOS/Vrooli Portal binaries
commands.assertions: x64 package contains Mach-O 64-bit x86_64 executable; arm64 package contains Mach-O 64-bit arm64 executable.

limitations: Cross-target package identity does not prove macOS installation, WindowServer interaction, Accessibility/ScreenCaptureKit permission, or revoke behavior.
Packages are unsigned; live macOS ARM64 acceptance remains not_run.
